description: This PHP source file handles the detailed view of a Role in a SuiteCRM (a SugarCRM fork). It manages access control, loads role data, and generates the HTML view including module assignments and navigation.

classes.name: DetailView
classes.description: Class responsible for processing detailed views of beans.

classes.name: TemplateGroupChooser
classes.description: Class for managing the selection interface for module groups.

classes.name: SubPanelTiles
classes.description: Class for rendering subpanels associated with a bean.

methods.name: processSugarBean
methods.description: Retrieves a bean based on request parameters, returns the bean object.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a summary string for a bean.

methods.name: processListNavigation
methods.description: Adds navigation controls to the template for list browsing.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the subpanel section for the bean.
